title: Guitar Practice Tracker — Exercises, Log and Stats
description: Managing your exercises and goal tempos in Guitar Practice, browsing and exporting your practice log, and reading the Stats charts.

scenes.text: This video covers your exercises, your practice log, and your stats.
The Exercises tab lists everything you practice, with your best tempo against your goal, a progress bar, when you last played it, and your total time.
Click an exercise to edit it, or press Add exercise. Give it a name, a technique, a subdivision, and a goal tempo. The ladder settings and a note are here too.
Tick Archived to hide an exercise you've finished with. Its history is kept.
The Log tab lists every session, by day. Click one to change it, or add an entry by hand.
Filter by exercise, technique, or date range, and export a spreadsheet file with Export CSV.
The Stats tab starts with your totals, then charts your minutes each day against your daily goal. Point at a bar for the details.
Below, see where your time goes, by technique and by exercise.
Progress charts your tempo on each exercise over time, with your goal as a dashed line. Point at a dot for the details.
That's exercises, the log, and stats. Happy practicing!
